changes.what: new; design 4.11 (the table of public-set.js), 4.3 (the regions), 5 (E14, E15), 7
detail: ORDER_TEXTS_PUBLIC = false (the G8 constant, typed boolean); GATES = Object.freeze({ langs: PUBLIC_LANGS, orderTexts: ORDER_TEXTS_PUBLIC }), PUBLIC_LANGS imported from ../public/shared/i18n/lang.js (one constant for the build and the function entry, criterion 9 (g)).

readRegions(html, file): the text split at \n; a marker line is exactly /^[ \t]*<!-- (\/?)sai:(order|kk) -->[ \t]*$/; every other line holding a marker-like comment (/<!--\s*\/?\s*sai\s*:/i) is refused, inside an open region as well (decisions/0124 H1); an opening marker opens a region only while none is open, the next marker line must be the end marker of its kind; the four Errors of 4.11 word for word with the file and the 1-based line; regions returned as { kind, from, to } with the 0-based indexes of the two marker lines.

stripRegions(html, kinds, file): removes the lines from…to of every region that readRegions gives whose kind is in kinds; every other line byte for byte; a page that cannot be read as regions throws before any cut; no kind to cut gives the same string.

renderTexts(langs, texts): one comment line, `export const LANGS = Object.freeze([...]);`, `export const TEXTS = Object.freeze({`, one line per key in source order `"<key>": Object.freeze({"<l>":"<value>",…}),` by JSON.stringify, `});`; a fixed point (measured: render, import, render again gives the same text).

writePublicSet(dir, gates = GATES) → Promise<{ changed, removed }>: (1) import of shared/i18n/texts.js with ?sha256=<hash of its bytes>, a failure rethrown as «shared/i18n/texts.js: the texts module cannot be imported: <its message>» with cause; export names exactly LANGS and TEXTS, else «… exports <the names>, not exactly LANGS and TEXTS»; (2) readRegions of every .html file before any write; (3) langs = the module's LANGS ∩ gates.langs in its order, keys without order_ unless gates.orderTexts, the file rewritten by renderTexts only when that drops a language or a key (else byte for byte); (4) examples.html removed unless gates.orderTexts; (5) every page cut from the text read at (2) by stripRegions with the closed kinds (order unless orderTexts, kk unless gates.langs holds kk), written only when it differs; (6) the .html files of the output read again from disk: a marker of a closed kind, an examples.html reference while orders are closed, an element data-lang="kk" while kk is closed each throw an Error naming the file; markers of an open kind stay.
